title.zh: 澳大利亚政治直播：阿尔巴尼斯称联盟党和一国党为“抱怨轴心”，泰勒就生活成本问题质询工党

summary.en: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese characterized the Coalition and One Nation parties as an “axis of grievance” amidst ongoing political debate, while opposition leader Peter Dutton's shadow treasurer, Angus Taylor, questioned the Labor government on the cost of living. The news also touched on charges against...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯在持续的政治辩论中，将联盟党和一国党描述为“抱怨轴心”，而反对党领袖彼得·达顿的影子财长安格斯·泰勒则就生活成本问题质询工党政府。新闻还提及了安永会计师事务所员工因访问总理银行账户详情而面临指控。

body.en: Follow today’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Albanese says charges against EY employees who accessed PM’s bank account details ‘appropriate’ It’s not just KPMG in (boiling) hot water right now; EY is also in the spotlight, after two of its graduate employees on secondment at the Commonwealth Bank allegedly used the bank’s systems to access the personal details of Anthony Albanese . The two employees have been sacked. It’s before the courts and I’m not about to go into the detail of that. It’s appropriate that charges have been laid …accessing anyone’s privacy, any Australian’s privacy, is alarming, let alone someone from a contractor who’s not an employee of Commonwealth Bank being able to access that information. We’ve cracked down on that and we’ll continue to examine these issues. Quite clearly, the behaviour of some of these big accounting firms has been completely unacceptable. In some cases, it has involved breaches of the law. And they need to be held to account. Since I’ve come into this role, I’ve really tried to prioritise drawing together a lot of strands of work that were already in play. And especially now that we’ve seen what’s happened with KPMG, we’re now accelerating a lot of the government’s work. Continue reading...
body.zh: 关注今日新闻直播 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 Albanese 表示，对获取 PM 银行账户详细信息的安永员工提出的指控是“适当的”。安永也受到关注，因为其两名借调到联邦银行的毕业生员工据称使用该银行的系统访问了安东尼·阿尔巴内塞的个人详细信息。这两名员工已被解雇。这是在法庭上进行的，我不打算透露细节。提出指控是适当的……访问任何人的隐私，任何澳大利亚人的隐私，都是令人震惊的，更不用说非联邦银行雇员的承包商的人能够访问这些信息了。我们已经对此进行了严厉打击，并将继续研究这些问题。很明显，其中一些大型会计师事务所的行为是完全不可接受的。在某些情况下，它涉及违法行为。他们需要承担责任。自从我担任这个角色以来，我确实尝试优先考虑将许多已经在进行的工作放在一起。尤其是现在我们已经看到毕马威发生的事情，我们现在正在加快政府的许多工作。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the realm of politics, it's easy to see opponents as the primary source of conflict, labeling their positions as an “axis of grievance.” Yet, Yahweh's Word reminds us that our true struggle is often not against other people, but against deeper spiritual forces that exploit human divisions. This perspective calls us to look beyond partisan labels and pray...
reflection.zh: 在政治领域，我们很容易将对手视为冲突的主要来源，将其立场贴上“抱怨轴心”的标签。然而，雅伟的话语提醒我们，我们真正的争战往往不是对抗人，而是对抗利用人类分歧的更深层属灵势力。这一视角呼吁我们超越党派标签，祈求智慧来解决不和的根本原因，而不仅仅是对表面分歧做出反应。

verse.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.

title.en: Friend of Thai teen allegedly murdered by Australian man went to his condo after reporting her missing

summary.en: A 17-year-old Thai girl has been reported missing and allegedly murdered. Security footage shows a friend, who reported her missing, later visited the apartment of the Australian man accused in connection with her disappearance.
summary.zh: 一名17岁的泰国少女被报失踪并据称遇害。监控录像显示，这名少女的朋友在报案后，曾前往与少女失踪案有关的澳大利亚男子的公寓。

body.en: Security footage images show a friend went to Simon Peter Carman’s apartment in Pattaya, Thailand after reporting Thunchanok Donhomla missing The friend of the 17-year-old girl allegedly murdered in Thailand reported her missing to police and then visited the condo of the Australian man charged over her death. Security footage images obtained by the Guardian shows the friend at the apartment of Simon Peter Carman. title.en: EU slaps €3 duty on low-value imported packages
title.zh: 欧盟对低价值进口包裹征收3欧元关税

summary.en: The European Union has implemented a €3 duty on low-value imported packages, aiming to address what it perceives as unfair competition from online retailers, primarily from China. This action follows a similar measure taken by the United States.
summary.zh: 欧盟已对低价值进口包裹征收3欧元的关税，旨在遏制其认为主要来自中国在线零售商的不公平竞争。此举与美国此前采取的类似措施相呼应。

body.en:
The EU has moved to curb what it sees as unfair competition from mostly Chinese online retailers by imposing its levy. It follows a similar move from the US.

The EU on Wednesday imposed a €3 ($3.40) levy on low-value e-commerce imports in a move to curb what it sees as unfair competition from online retailers , notably Chinese firms such as Shein, Temu and AliExpress.

This comes as the number of such parcels entering the bloc under a previous exemption for goods valued under €150 rose dramatically from 1.4 billion in 2022 to 5.8 billion in 2025.

The European Commission, which controls EU trade policy, says the step aims not only to prevent companies exploiting the previous exemption to gain a competitive advantage but to stop the import of goods that do not meet the bloc's safety standards.

It also says that customs authorities have been overwhelmed by the number of small packages coming from overseas and were unable to carry out requisite checks properly.

European businesses, for their part, have complained that while they are forced to comply with strict EU standards, many products from abroad do not meet them.

During inspections across the EU in 2025, it was found that over 60% of imported items such as toys, cosmetics and electronics contained banned ingredients or lacked safety paperwork.

In May, Chinese online retailer  Temu was handed a €200 million fine for sending products to the EU, such as baby toys and small electronics, that did not meet the bloc's consumer safety standards.

The €3 fee is to be imposed for each different class of item, meaning that a parcel with three different kinds of goods will incur a €9 levy, while one containing several articles of the same sort will stay at the €3 charge.

However, from July 1, 2028, when the new EU Customs Authority is meant to start operations, different duties according to the goods category will replace the flat rate imposed on Wednesday.

The US ended its "de minimis" exemption for imports from China in May and for all imports at the end of August, and Britain is soon also to follow suit.

Some EU countries have already introduced their own levies but these will be superseded by those imposed by the bloc. France, for example, has said it will scrap a €2 levy now that the EU has imposed its fee.

Chinese e-commerce platform Shein has already prepared for the change by increasing its warehouse space  in Wroclaw, Poland, and stepping up its bulk shipping to the EU.

Although the levy is to be paid by the exporters themselves, online platforms are expected to pass on at least some of the additional costs to consumers.

They might also bring pressure to bear on suppliers to lower their prices to ensure continued profitability.

body.zh: 欧盟已采取行动，通过征收关税来遏制其认为主要来自中国在线零售商的不公平竞争。此前美国也采取了类似举措。 欧盟周三对低价值电子商务进口商品征收 3 欧元（3.40 美元）的关税，以遏制来自在线零售商（尤其是 Shein、Temu 和 AliExpress 等中国公司）的不公平竞争。 与此同时，根据之前价值 150 欧元以下商品的豁免进入欧盟的此类包裹数量从 2022 年的 14 亿件大幅增加到 2025 年的 58 亿件。 控制欧盟贸易政策的欧盟委员会表示，这一举措不仅旨在防止企业利用之前的豁免获得竞争优势，而且还旨在阻止进口不符合欧盟安全标准的商品。 报告还称，海关当局因来自海外的小包裹数量而不堪重负，无法正确进行必要的检查。 欧洲企业则抱怨说，虽然他们被迫遵守严格的欧盟标准，但许多来自国外的产品并不符合这些标准。 在2025年欧盟各地的检查中，发现玩具、化妆品和电子产品等超过60%的进口商品含有违禁成分或缺乏安全文件。 今年 5 月，中国在线零售商 Temu 因向欧盟发送不符合欧盟消费者安全标准的婴儿玩具和小型电子产品等产品而被处以 2 亿欧元罚款。 每种不同类别的物品均需缴纳 3 欧元的费用，这意味着包含三种不同种类商品的包裹将征收 9 欧元的税，而包含多件同类物品的包裹将收取 3 欧元的费用。 然而，从 2028 年 7 月 1 日起，新的欧盟海关当局开始运作，根据商品类别征收的不同关税将取代周三征收的统一税率。 美国于 5 月终止了对来自中国的进口产品的“最低限度”豁免，并于 8 月底终止了对所有进口产品的“最低限度”豁免，英国也很快将效仿。 一些欧盟国家已经引入了自己的税收，但这些税收将被欧盟征收的税收所取代。例如，法国已表示，既然欧盟已经征收了 2 欧元的费用，法国将取消该费用。 中国电子商务平台 Shein 已经为这一变化做好了准备，增加了在波兰弗罗茨瓦夫的仓库空间，并加大了对欧盟的散货运输力度。 尽管征税将由出口商自己支付，但预计在线平台将至少将部分额外成本转嫁给消费者。 他们还可能向供应商施加压力，要求其降低价格，以确保持续盈利。 欧盟此举...

reflection.en: This news highlights the ongoing challenge of ensuring fair practices in global commerce. Yahweh's word reminds us that honest dealings and just measures are not merely economic policies, but reflections of integrity that honor Him. As nations navigate complex trade relationships, the pursuit of equity remains a foundational principle for true prosperity.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了在全球贸易中确保公平竞争的持续挑战。雅伟的话语提醒我们，诚实的交易和公正的衡量标准不仅仅是经济政策，更是反映正直、荣耀祂的品格。当各国处理复杂的贸易关系时，追求公平仍然是真正繁荣的基石。

title.en: Three-year-old rescued and taken to hospital six days after Venezuela quake
title.zh: 委内瑞拉地震六天后，一名三岁儿童获救并送医

summary.en: A three-year-old child was rescued and taken to hospital six days after an earthquake struck Venezuela. Video footage captured rescuers cheering as the child was pulled from the rubble in La Guaira state.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉地震发生六天后，一名三岁儿童获救并被送往医院。视频画面显示，救援人员在拉瓜伊拉州将孩子从废墟中救出时欢呼雀跃。

body.en:
A three-year-old boy has been pulled alive from the rubble six days after the devastating earthquakes in Venezuela, a Jordanian rescue team has said.

The child, named as Klieber Morán, was pulled from wreckage in La Guaira state, interim President Delcy Rodríguez said. Rodríguez described the child's rescue as a "source of hope for our people".

It comes as UN warned that tens of thousands of people were urgently in need of food and shelter.

The death toll from last week's quakes - with magnitudes of 7.2 and 7.5 - has risen to 1,943 with more than 10,000 people injured and tens of thousands more unaccounted for.

The massive tremors probably damaged or destroyed 58,870 buildings, according to an initial assessment of satellite data from Nasa.

The Jordanian civil defence said Klieber had been given first aid treatment, taken to a hospital and his vital signs were good. He was being treated in the capital Caracas, Venezuelan Assembly President Jorge Rodríguez said.

The rescue comes well after the initial three-day period immediately after the quake during which experts say people trapped under debris have the best chance of being found alive.

La Guaira is one of the hardest hit areas, with many local people trying to carry out rescue efforts themselves .

The UN's refugee agency said on Tuesday that food shortages were widespread, basic services had broken down and communications had been largely severed in La Guaira.

"Community tensions are rising as access to assistance remains constrained," the UNHCR said in a statement on its website.

Daniela Armas, an 18-year-old vendor in La Guaira who was injured falling from a motorbike when the quakes struck, told AFP that some supplies were being distributed "but sometimes people nearly kill each other for food... it's like a cockfight."

The UNHCR said that it needed an initial $15m to "scale up protection, core relief items, and temporary shelter support for 30,000 earthquake-affected people over six months".

Meanwhile the World Health Organization (WHO) said health services were under "extreme pressure."

"There's an increased risk now of outbreaks of vaccine-preventable diseases" such as measles and diphtheria due to low vaccination coverage, WHO spokesman Christian Lindmeier said.

Jorge Rodríguez said Klieber's rescue showed there was still hope of continuing to find people alive and that domestic and international teams were still searching through rubble. Shelters were already open in La Guaira and other states, he added.

International rescue teams from the US, Mexico and dozens of other countries searched for survivors with trained dogs and heavy equipment.

This scene echoes the truth that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes with the morning, a testament to enduring hope. reflection.zh: 孩子被困瓦砾数日后获救，这有力地提醒我们，即使在最深的悲痛中，喜乐的时刻也能冲破黑暗。这一幕呼应了“一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼”的真理，是持久盼望的明证。它提醒我们，即使一切似乎都已失去，生命仍能出现，带来安慰和庆祝，这是雅伟的恩赐。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: Wednesday briefing: After two powerful earthquakes, what is the reality on the ground in Venezuela?
title.zh: 周三简报：两次强震后，委内瑞拉的真实情况如何？

summary.en: Venezuela is grappling with the aftermath of two powerful earthquakes, adding to an existing national crisis following the removal of its leader earlier this year. The country now faces the challenge of rebuilding with limited state presence.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉在两次强震之后，正面临重建的挑战，而该国自今年早些时候领导人被美国罢免以来，已处于危机之中，且国家机构在重建中作用有限。

body.en: In today’s newsletter: A country already in crisis since the removal of its leader earlier this year by the US, now has to find a way to rebuild with little state presence in evidence The shaking seemed to come from nowhere. In a moment captured by fishers off Venezuela’s Caribbean coast, two earthquakes struck seconds apart . Plumes of dust appear where buildings once stood in the recording as the camera rises and falls with the swell. The men rapidly head for the shore in search of their families. “I’m shaking,” says the cameraman. Since the quakes struck last Wednesday, the search for missing loved ones has not stopped for scores of Venezuelans. Officially, more than 1,700 people have died. But tens of thousands remain missing: desperate relatives are walking up and down streets lined by rubble and collapsed buildings with photos of those they cannot find, asking for help. World news | A child has been rescued from the rubble in Venezuela, six days since the country was hit by devastating twin earthquakes. UK politics | Andy Burnham will have to find an extra £4.7bn for defence in his first budget, after Keir Starmer announced a £298bn defence investment plan (Dip) without having fully identified how it will be funded. US politics | The US supreme court has upheld the constitutional guarantee of birthright citizenship, affirming that nearly all people born on US soil are American citizens and rejecting a central pillar of Donald Trump’s anti-immigrant agenda. UK news | The European media group Axel Springer has completed its £575m takeover of the Telegraph, ending years of uncertainty over the future ownership of the 171-year-old titles. US news | Nine matches in the World Cup group stage were played amid potentially dangerous heat and humidity, a Guardian analysis shows. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在今天的时事通讯中：一个自今年早些时候被美国罢黜领导人以来就已经陷入危机的国家，现在必须找到一种在几乎没有国家存在的情况下进行重建的方法。震动似乎是从无到有的。在委内瑞拉加勒比海沿岸渔民捕捉到的瞬间，两场地震相隔数秒发生。随着摄像机随着海浪的起伏，在录像中曾经矗立的建筑物上出现了羽状尘埃。这些人迅速前往岸边寻找家人。 “我在发抖，”摄影师说。自上周三发生地震以来，数十名委内瑞拉人一直在寻找失踪亲人。据官方统计，已有 1,700 多人死亡。但仍有数万人失踪：绝望的亲属带着他们找不到的人的照片，在废墟和倒塌的建筑物两旁的街道上走来走去，寻求帮助。世界新闻 |委内瑞拉遭受毁灭性的​​两次地震袭击六天后，一名儿童从废墟中被救出。英国政治 |在凯尔·斯塔默宣布一项 2980 亿英镑的国防投资计划 (Dip) 后，安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 必须在他的第一份预算中额外找到 47 亿英镑用于国防，但尚未完全确定该计划的资金来源。美国政治 |美国最高法院维护了出生公民权的宪法保障，确认几乎所有在美国领土上出生的人都是美国公民，并拒绝了唐纳德·特朗普反移民议程的核心支柱。英国新闻|欧洲媒体集团阿克塞尔·施普林格 (Axel Springer) 完成了对《电讯报》的 5.75 亿英镑收购，结束了这些拥有 171 年历史的报纸未来所有权多年来的不确定性。美国新闻 |卫报的分析显示，世界杯小组赛的九场比赛是在潜在危险的炎热和潮湿的环境下进行的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Venezuela faces immense challenges, grappling with the aftermath of powerful earthquakes while already navigating deep political and economic instability. In such prolonged and devastating circumstances, the prophet's words remind us that Yahweh's mercies are new every morning, offering a fresh source of hope and strength even when human structures falter....
reflection.zh: 委内瑞拉正面临巨大挑战，在经历强震之后，又要在深刻的政治和经济动荡中挣扎。在这样持久而毁灭性的困境中，先知的话语提醒我们，雅伟的慈爱每早晨都是新的，即使在人类的结构摇摇欲坠时，也能提供新的希望和力量。这种持久的信实能够支撑社区在持续的损失中努力重建。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: US Supreme Court upholds birthright citizenship in blow to Trump
title.zh: 美国最高法院维持出生公民权，特朗普受挫

summary.en: The US Supreme Court has upheld birthright citizenship, a decision that marks a significant setback for Donald Trump's immigration policies and has been welcomed by civil rights organizations.
summary.zh: 美国最高法院维持了出生公民权，这一裁决对唐纳德·特朗普的移民议程构成重大挫折，并受到民权团体的欢迎。

body.en:
The Supreme Court has ruled that babies born in the US have a constitutional right to citizenship, rejecting Donald Trump's bid to end the 150-year-old policy.

In a 6-3 decision, Chief Justice John Roberts ruled that children born in the US "to parents unlawfully or temporarily present" are "citizens at birth" under the 14th amendment.

President Trump had sought to limit the right through an executive order, arguing that the children of undocumented immigrants and some temporary visitors were not "subject to the jurisdiction thereof", and thus not eligible for birthright citizenship.

The ruling is a major setback for Trump's immigration agenda, and has been welcomed by civil rights groups.

Five of the justices, including Chief Justice Roberts, agreed that Trump's executive order violates the Constitution's 14th Amendment. Justice Brett Kavanaugh wrote separately to say believes the order is in violation of federal law.

On Truth Social, Trump said that the court's decision was "too bad" and vowed to continue to fight to end birthright citizenship through legislation.

"No long and unwieldy constitutional amendment is necessary," he said. "Congress should today start work on ending expensive, and unfair to our country, birthright citizenship."

The US has granted citizenship to everyone born in the country since 1868, with the right enshrined in the 14th Amendment of the US Constitution, and bolstered by later US Supreme Court rulings.

Passed in the aftermath of the US civil war, the 14th Amendment - which was originally intended for recently freed slaves - reads that "all persons born or naturalised, and subject to the jurisdiction thereof, are citizens of the United States"

"Citizenship, then and now, was the right to have rights - to freely participate in our political community," Justice Roberts wrote in the majority opinion. "The Framers of the Fourteenth Amendment extended that promise to 'every free-born person in this land'," he wrote.

The Trump administration argued that the "jurisdiction thereof" mentioned in the 14th Amendment should exclude children of people who do not live in the country permanently.

Three of the court's nine justices dissented from the decision: Justices Clarence Thomas, Neil Gorsuch and Samuel Alito.

Justice Thomas argued that the 14th amendment was being "repurposed for political projects" and that the freed slaves it was originally intended for "were Americans" with no allegiance to other countries.

Another of the dissenting Justices, Samuel Alito, described the ruling as a "serious mistake" that "confers citizenship on virtually anyone who happens to be born in this country", including those who come to the US with the explicit purpose of giving birth to a child and then returning to their country of...
body.zh: 最高法院裁定，在美国出生的婴儿享有宪法赋予的公民权，驳回了唐纳德·特朗普终止这项已有 150 年政策的提议。 首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨 (John Roberts) 以 6 比 3 的投票结果裁定，根据第 14 条修正案，“父母非法或暂时在美国”出生的孩子是“出生时的公民”。 特朗普总统曾试图通过一项行政命令限制这一权利，认为无证移民和一些临时访客的子女不“受其管辖”，因此没有资格获得与生俱来的公民身份。 这项裁决是特朗普移民议程的重大挫折，并受到民权组织的欢迎。 包括首席大法官罗伯茨在内的五名法官一致认为，特朗普的行政命令违反了宪法第十四修正案。法官布雷特·卡瓦诺(Brett Kavanaugh)单独写信表示，他认为该命令违反了联邦法律。 特朗普在《Truth Social》节目中表示，法院的判决“太糟糕了”，并发誓将继续努力通过立法终结与生俱来的公民身份。 “没有必要进行又长又笨拙的宪法修正案，”他说。 “国会应该从今天开始致力于结束昂贵且对我们国家不公平的与生俱来的公民身份。” 自 1868 年以来，美国向在该国出生的每个人授予公民身份，这一权利载入美国宪法第 14 条修正案，并得到后来美国最高法院裁决的支持。 美国内战后通过的第十四修正案最初是针对最近被释放的奴隶的，其中规定“所有出生或归化并受其管辖的人都是美国公民” 罗伯茨法官在多数意见中写道：“无论过去还是现在，公民身份都是享有权利的权利——自由参与我们的政治社区。” “第十四修正案的制定者将这一承诺延伸到了‘这片土地上每一个生来自由的人’，”他写道。 特朗普政府辩称，第十四修正案中提到的“管辖权”应排除非永久居住在该国的人的子女。 法院的九名法官中有三名对这一决定持异议：法官克拉伦斯·托马斯、尼尔·戈萨奇和塞缪尔·阿利托。 托马斯法官辩称，第十四修正案正在“重新用于政治项目”，而它最初的目的是为“美国人”提供自由，不效忠其他国家。 另一位持反对意见的法官塞缪尔·阿利托 (Samuel Alito) 称该裁决是一个“严重错误”，“几乎向所有恰好出生在这个国家的人授予公民身份”，包括那些明确目的是生孩子然后返回自己国家的人。

reflection.en: This Supreme Court ruling affirms a principle of belonging for those born within a nation's borders, a concept echoed in ancient wisdom. Yahweh's law called for foreigners residing in the land to be treated as native-born, reminding the people of their own history as strangers. This decision underscores the importance of upholding the dignity and rights of...
reflection.zh: 最高法院的这项裁决，确认了在本国境内出生者的归属原则，这与古老的智慧不谋而合。雅伟的律法要求，居住在境内的外国人应被视为本地人，以此提醒百姓他们自己也曾是寄居者。这项裁决强调了维护所有个体尊严和权利的重要性，无论其父母的出身如何。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: ‘Complicated and expensive’: Burnham is right about the risks of nationalisation | Nils Pratley
title.zh: “复杂且昂贵”：伯纳姆对国有化风险的看法是正确的

summary.en: The article discusses the complexities and costs associated with nationalizing utilities, using Welsh Water's return to public ownership as an example. It suggests that public ownership may not be a universal solution to the challenges faced by the utilities sector.
summary.zh: 这篇文章讨论了公用事业国有化的复杂性和成本，以威尔士水务公司回归公有制为例。文章指出，公有制可能并非解决公用事业部门所有困境的万能药。

body.en: Track record of Welsh Water shows public ownership is not the answer to all the woes in the utilities sector Good news for Andy Burnham: one of the original 10 water privatisations from the Thatcher-era has returned to public ownership already. Thanks to a complicated turn-of-the-century corporate saga, Welsh Water, serving 3 million people, converted to not-for-profit status in 2001. It has no shareholders. Financial surpluses go “straight back into keeping bills down and looking after your water and beautiful environment”, as the website blurb puts it . How’s it going? After a quarter of a century without dividend-hungry shareholders to feed, has the model proved its superiority? Not exactly. Welsh Water usually has high scores on customer trust metrics but its performance on bills and spills tends to be middle of the pack. Continue reading...
body.zh: 威尔士水务公司的业绩记录表明，公有制并不能解决公用事业行业所有问题。对安迪·伯纳姆来说，好消息是：撒切尔时代最初的 10 项水务私有化之一已经回归公有制。由于世纪之交复杂的企业传奇，为 300 万人提供服务的威尔士水务公司 (Welsh Water) 在 2001 年转变为非营利组织。它没有股东。正如网站简介所言，财务盈余“直接用于降低账单并照顾您的水和美丽的环境”。怎么样了？在四分之一个世纪没有满足渴望分红的股东的情况下，该模式是否证明了其优越性？不完全是。威尔士水务公司在客户信任度指标上通常得分很高，但在账单和泄漏方面的表现往往处于中等水平。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Debates over public versus private ownership of essential services like water often center on how best to ensure justice and care for all citizens. Yahweh's call to leaders is to “do justice and righteousness,” ensuring the vulnerable are protected and no one is wronged. This principle reminds us that the ultimate goal of any system should be to serve the...
reflection.zh: 关于水等基本服务应由公共还是私人所有，其争论的核心往往是如何最好地确保所有公民的公平与关怀。雅伟呼召领袖们“施行公平和公义”，确保弱势群体受到保护，无人受害。这一原则提醒我们，任何制度的最终目标都应是以正直和怜悯之心服务于共同利益。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Radhika had a path out of early marriage — until a decision by Donald Trump destroyed it
title.zh: 拉迪卡摆脱早婚之路，因特朗普一项决定而断绝

summary.en: The news reports that a political decision in 2025 led to the dismantling of the world's largest humanitarian aid donor. One year later, the consequences are described as devastating, impacting individuals like Radhika, who lost her opportunity to avoid early marriage.
summary.zh: 新闻报道称，2025年一项政治决定导致全球最大的国际人道主义援助机构被解散。一年后，其影响被描述为毁灭性的，对像拉迪卡这样失去摆脱早婚机会的个人造成了冲击。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Radhika Yadav harbours a fear no child should: that she'll be forced to marry before she turns 18.

In Nepal, where the 13-year-old lives, it's one shared by millions. The country is home to five million child brides, and Yadav knows she could soon become one of them.

UDAAN, an education program run by CARE International for girls aged 10 to 14 who have never attended school or dropped out early, gave her a glimmer of hope. The intensive 11-month curriculum is designed to transition girls into formal education and help open doors to them that poverty and tradition had slammed shut.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Then, in 2025, funding for the program — CARE says the name means "flight" or "flying high" — was cut and the school closed overnight. Yadav and 307 other girls were sent home; their daily studies replaced with daily chores.

"Before, I was learning new things every day. I was excited about going to school again," Radhika told CARE International.

Yadav's mother, Sundar Kala, watched her daughter transform at UDAAN — learning to read, write, count and speak up for herself. After the program stopped, she watched that confidence drain away.

For girls in disadvantaged communities in Nepal, the risks multiply. School attendance means sacrificing immediate income, as girls are often required to work to earn money for their families. So, when resources are scarce, sons take priority.

Yet girls who don't go to school are far more vulnerable to early marriage, gender-based violence and trafficking, including to India and the Gulf states, where they may be forced into domestic servitude or exploitative labour.

The funding cuts at UDAAN impacted more than 300 girls, but this is a global problem.

Approximately 12 million girls are married before the age of 18 each year, according to the Institute of Global Politics, which warns that "significant cuts in foreign assistance" are slowing or even reversing progress.

UNICEF USA warns that steep cuts to global education funding could push six million more children out of school in the coming year.

Yadav's story is part of a global crisis that began on 20 January 2025 — United States President Donald Trump's first day back in office.

Trump ordered a near-total freeze on US foreign aid, and on 1 July, the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) was shuttered. Some 83 per cent of its programs were cancelled, and its remaining functions were absorbed into the State Department.

Aid organisations scrambled in the aftermath: UN agencies reliant on the funding...
body.zh: 分享您的反馈并帮助我们改进此功能。请在此处详细了解我们如何在 SBS 使用人工智能。 拉迪卡·亚达夫 (Radhika Yadav) 怀有一种孩子不该有的恐惧：她将被迫在 18 岁之前结婚。 在这名 13 岁男孩所居住的尼泊尔，数百万人都面临着同样的问题。这个国家有五百万童养媳，亚达夫知道她很快就会成为其中之一。 UDAAN 是 CARE International 为 10 至 14 岁从未上过学或提早辍学的女孩开设的教育项目，这给了她一线希望。为期 11 个月的强化课程旨在帮助女孩接受正规教育，并帮助她们打开因贫困和传统而关闭的大门。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然后，到了 2025 年，该项目的资金——CARE 说这个名字的意思是“飞行”或“飞得很高”——被削减，学校连夜关闭。 Yadav 和其他 307 名女孩被送回家；他们的日常学习被日常琐事所取代。 “以前，我每天都在学习新事物。我很高兴能再次上学，”拉迪卡告诉国际关怀组织。 亚达夫的母亲桑达尔·卡拉 (Sundar Kala) 见证了女儿在 UDAAN 的转变——学习阅读、写作、计数和为自己说话。节目停止后，她看着信心逐渐消失。 对于尼泊尔弱势社区的女孩来说，风险成倍增加。上学意味着牺牲直接收入，因为女孩常常需要工作来养家糊口。所以，当资源匮乏时，儿子优先。 然而，不上学的女孩更容易遭受早婚、性别暴力和贩运，包括被贩运到印度和海湾国家，在那里她们可能被迫成为家庭奴役或剥削性劳动。 UDAAN 的资金削减影响了 300 多名女孩，但这是一个全球性问题。 全球政治研究所的数据显示，每年约有 1200 万女孩在 18 岁之前结婚，该研究所警告称，“外国援助的大幅削减”正在减缓甚至逆转进展。 联合国儿童基金会美国分部警告称，全球教育经费的大幅削减可能导致明年新增 600 万儿童失学。 亚达夫的故事是始于 2025 年 1 月 20 日（美国总统唐纳德·特朗普上任第一天）的全球危机的一部分。 特朗普下令几乎完全冻结美国对外援助，7 月 1 日，美国国际开发署 (USAID) 被关闭。其约 83% 的项目被取消，其剩余职能被并入国务院。 援助组织陷入困境：联合国机构依赖资金......

reflection.en: The dismantling of vital humanitarian aid, as highlighted by Radhika's story, reminds us of the profound impact political decisions have on the most vulnerable. Yahweh's call in Isaiah 58:7 urges us not to turn away from those in need, but to actively share resources and provide shelter. This story serves as a sober reminder of our collective responsibility...
reflection.zh: 正如拉迪卡的故事所强调的，重要人道主义援助的解散，提醒我们政治决策对最弱势群体产生的深远影响。雅伟在以赛亚书58:7中的呼吁，敦促我们不要对有需要的人视而不见，而是要积极分享资源并提供庇护。这个故事警醒我们，有责任秉持怜悯之心，确保为那些面临困境的人提供支持。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Nationality dispute: What does an Indian passport prove?
title.zh: 国籍争议：印度护照能证明什么？

summary.en: A passport controversy has reignited debate over how citizenship is proven in India, with voter-list revisions exposing systemic gaps and raising fears of wrongful exclusion.
summary.zh: 一场护照争议重新引发了印度关于如何证明公民身份的辩论，选民名单的修订暴露了系统性漏洞，并引发了对错误排斥的担忧。

body.en:
A passport controversy has reignited debate over how citizenship is proven in India, with voter-list revisions exposing systemic gaps and raising fears of wrongful exclusion.

For decades, Indian citizenship was rarely questioned. Most people voted, obtained passports, enrolled in welfare schemes and went about their lives without having to demonstrate that they belonged in the country in which they were born. That assumption is steadily changing.

Last week, a senior official of India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said the Indian passport is primarily a travel document and should not be treated as a conclusive proof of citizenship , according to Indian media reports. Legally, that distinction is not new.

Former diplomat Veena Sikri notes that the Ministry of Home Affairs — not the MEA — has the sole authority to grant and determine citizenship.

"A passport is an attribute of citizenship, but does not itself confer it," Sikri told DW.

The MEA official's reported statement comes at a time when citizenship itself has become one of India's most politically contested subjects.

It also coincides with the election commission's ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in several states and territories, including Bihar — one of India's largest states by population — and West Bengal, where Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party recently won state elections .

The Election Commission of India (ECI) said the "intensive revision" was needed to remove ineligible voters, but critics say it is skewed against marginalized and minority communities. 

Members of Modi's Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) have long claimed that large numbers of undocumented  Muslim migrants from neighboring Bangladesh  have fraudulently entered India's electoral rolls. 

India's citizenship law does not provide most people with a single document that conclusively proves their status.

Instead, different documents serve different purposes. The Aadhaar biometric card establishes identity for welfare and public services. A voter identity card enables electoral participation. A passport certifies nationality for international travel. Birth certificates, school records and land documents may all become relevant in different circumstances. 

Rebecca Mammen John, a senior lawyer who has studied the issue closely, says the real problem is that India has no universal document that conclusively establishes citizenship.

"A passport is issued only to an Indian citizen under the Passports Act, yet the government does not issue any separate citizenship certificate to people who acquire citizenship by birth or descent," she told DW.

title.en: Donald Trump's bumper day of wins, losses, and growing power
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在一天之内经历胜败参半，权力日益增长

summary.en: Over a single day, the US Supreme Court issued significant rulings concerning former President Donald Trump's key policies, resulting in a mix of legal victories and defeats for his agenda.
summary.zh: 在一天之内，美国最高法院就前总统唐纳德·特朗普的一些标志性政策做出了重大裁决，使其议程在法律上既有胜利也有挫折。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump has faced mixed Supreme Court ruling streak, with the country's highest judicial chamber delivering both victories and defeats for several of his centrepiece policies.

The Supreme Court is where many of Trump's executive orders, like the sweeping and broad-ranging policy declarations signed in the first months of his presidency , are scrutinised by judges appointed by the state.

On Tuesday, the final sitting day for the term, the court's nine government-appointed judges passed long-awaited decisions on some of Trump's most controversial executive orders, laws and edicts.

They range from immigration to transgender participation in sport, to one of Trump's most scandalous firings.

Trump suffered a massive blow to the anti-immigration initiatives at the heart of his second presidency after the Supreme Court rejected a bid to restrict birthright citizenship.

The move was part of a raft of executive orders signed on the first day of his second stint at the White House, announcing that children born to parents in the United States who were there illegally or on temporary visas would not automatically become US citizens.

On Tuesday, the court ruled 6-3 to maintain the right to American citizenship for nearly everyone born on US soil — even when their parents are not US citizens.

"Children born in the United States to parents unlawfully or temporarily present are 'subject to the jurisdiction' of the United States and are citizens at birth under the Fourteenth Amendment's Citizenship Clause," chief justice John Roberts wrote in the court's opinion.

SBS News previously reported that Trump's move drew parallels with reforms introduced in 1986 under the Hawke government. In Australia, children of temporary residents qualify for citizenship after living in the country for the first 10 years of their lives.

Following the ruling, the US Justice Department released a memo directing prosecutors to investigate "birth tourism" and promising to "zealously protect the sanctity of United States citizenship".

The executive order was part of a broader campaign to limit immigration, with widespread detention and deportations sparking protest and unrest across the country .

The Supreme Court thwarted Trump's bid to fire one of the governors of the Federal Reserve — the US central bank.

Lisa Cook was the first black woman to sit on the Federal Reserve Board of Governors. The former economics professor was appointed to the board by the Biden administration in 2022.

title.en: Anthropic says US lifts export ban on its advanced AI tools
title.zh: Anthropic称美国解除对其先进人工智能工具的出口禁令

summary.en: Anthropic announced that the US government has lifted an export ban on its advanced AI tools, Fable and Mythos. The tools had been suspended in June due to concerns they could be exploited by hackers.
summary.zh: Anthropic公司宣布，美国政府已解除对其先进人工智能工具Fable和Mythos的出口禁令。此前，这些工具于六月因担忧可能被黑客利用而暂停出口。

body.en:
The US government has lifted an export ban on Anthropic's most advanced artificial intelligence (AI) tools, just weeks after ordering it to restrict access to them over national security concerns, the company has said.

Anthropic said in a statement that it will begin restoring access to Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 on Wednesday after being notified that the US Department of Commerce has lifted restrictions on the two models.

They are the firm's most advanced AI tools, which were abruptly suspended on 12 June over concerns that they could be used by hackers to exploit weaknesses in computer systems.

The Commerce Department said in a letter seen by the BBC that Anthropic has addressed the risks.

"Anthropic has agreed to proactively detect and address security risks associated with the models," Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick wrote in a letter to the tech company.

The firm has also agreed to collaborate on future releases of its AI models and alert the government of any malicious activity, Lutnick wrote.

The Commerce Department reserves the right to reconsider its decision to lift export restrictions if necessary, he added.

Mythos and Fable are two of Anthropic's AI models built on its Claude platform - a rival to the likes of OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Gemini.

Fable 5 is a version of the AI model for the consumer market, capable of deep reasoning and can perform complex tasks independently.

Mythos 5 is a version of the platform designed for businesses and cybersecurity experts. It is said to be able to identify vulnerabilities in computer code and exploit them. Both models were released on 9 June.

The firm previously said that US authorities had not pinpointed specific concerns about its technology even as it ordered both platforms to be suspended around the world.

"Our understanding is that the government believes it has become aware of a method of bypassing, or 'jailbreaking' Fable 5," the company said at the time, referring to a process of slipping past software safety restrictions to unblock features.

"However, we disagree that the finding of a narrow potential jailbreak should be cause for recalling a commercial model deployed to hundreds of millions of people."
body.zh: Anthropic 表示，美国政府已取消对 Anthropic 最先进人工智能 (AI) 工具的出口管制，而就在几周前，出于国家安全考虑，美国政府下令限制对这些工具的访问。 Anthropic 在社交媒体帖子中表示，在获悉美国商务部取消对这两款机型的出口管制后，该公司将于周三开始恢复对《克劳德寓言 5》和《神话 5》的访问。 它们是该公司最先进的人工智能工具，但由于担心黑客可能利用它们来利用计算机系统的弱点，该工具于 6 月 12 日被突然暂停。 Mythos 和 Fable 是 Anthropic 的两个人工智能模型，建立在其 Claude 平台上，是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 和谷歌的 Gemini 等模型的竞争对手。 《神鬼寓言5》是面向消费市场的AI模型版本，能够进行深度推理，能够独立执行复杂的任务。 Mythos 5 是专为企业和网络安全专家设计的平台版本。据说它能够识别计算机代码中的漏洞并利用它们。 该公司此前表示，尽管美国当局下令在全球范围内暂停这两个平台，但并未明确指出对其技术的具体担忧。 该公司当时表示：“我们的理解是，政府认为它已经意识到了一种绕过或‘越狱’《神鬼寓言 5》的方法。”指的是绕过软件安全限制以解锁功能的过程。 “然而，我们不认为，发现一个狭窄的潜在越狱应该成为召回部署到数亿人的商业模式的理由。”

reflection.en: The temporary ban on advanced AI tools, due to concerns about their misuse, highlights the critical need for foresight in technological development. Just as the prudent see danger and take refuge, wisdom calls us to anticipate potential harms and act responsibly when creating powerful innovations.
reflection.zh: 由于担心先进人工智能工具可能被滥用而实施的临时禁令，凸显了技术发展中预见性思维的关键需求。正如明智人预见危险并采取避险措施，智慧也呼唤我们在创造强大创新时，预见潜在危害并负责任地行事。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Trump made more than $1bn from crypto in first year back in office
title.zh: 特朗普卸任第一年从加密货币中赚取逾10亿美元

summary.en: The former president reportedly earned over $1 billion from various commercial ventures, including cryptocurrency, real estate, and branded merchandise, during his first year out of office.
summary.zh: 据报道，这位前总统在卸任后的第一年里，通过加密货币、房地产和品牌商品等多种商业活动，收入超过10亿美元。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump made more than $1bn (£750m) last year from business dealings in cryptocurrency, according to his mandatory financial report for 2025.

In a 927-page disclosure, he reported $635m in royalties from a Trump meme coin that has plunged in value since he launched it days before taking office.

He also reported over $500m in income from World Liberty Financial, a cryptocurrency firm founded by his own sons and the children of his special envoy, Steve Witkoff.

He earned millions more from real estate and Trump-themed items. But the White House denied he was profiting from the presidency.

The earnings from his latest financial disclosure far outpace the previous ones for 2024, when Trump disclosed over $600m of income.

But the White House, which has repeatedly emphasised that Trump has placed his businesses in a trust managed by his sons, again denied any conflict of interest.

White House deputy press secretary Anna Kelly said the president had proudly made the US "the crypto capital of the world".

"Neither the President nor his family has ever engaged - or will ever engage - in conflicts of interest," she said in a statement.

She added: "All actions by President Trump and his administration are taken in the best interest of the American people – and any so-called 'reporters' pushing otherwise are recycling the same, tired, false narrative that Democrats and the legacy media have been pushing for a decade."

The president himself has also highlighted that he is not subject to federal conflict of interest laws.

Trump once criticised cryptocurrency, famously calling Bitcoin a "scam" and a "disaster waiting to happen".

But Tuesday's disclosure shows his crypto earnings far overshadow income from his real estate business, which first catapulted him to fame.

He earned around $77m from his Mar-a-Lago club and $122m from his golf club in Doral, Florida.

He also earned more than $30m each from golf clubs in Bedminster, New Jersey, and Jupiter, Florida, and Turnberry, Scotland.

Trump also earned millions from other business ventures, according to the financial disclosure.

These included $4.7m in royalties from Trump-branded watches, along with Trump-branded Bibles, trainers, fragrances and guitars.

First Lady Melania Trump also listed her income from 2025 in the disclosure. She made $10.7m from a "license agreement" related to the documentary about her that was released last year.

Another $6m in income is listed for her from the sale of NFTs, which are digital images sold online.

The president listed some $86.5m of income in settlements from various legal actions.

These included $16m from a lawsuit against ABC, $16m from CBS Broadcasting and CBS Interactive, $24.5m from Meta, $22m from YouTube and $8m from X.

title.en: Venezuela: Death toll nears 2,000 as rescue hopes fade
title.zh: 委内瑞拉：死亡人数逼近2,000，救援希望渺茫

summary.en: After devastating earthquakes in Venezuela, nearly 2,000 people are confirmed dead, and approximately 43,000 remain missing. Aid agencies are warning of escalating hunger and disease as the healthcare system is overwhelmed.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉地震后，近2,000人被确认死亡，约43,000人失踪。援助机构警告称，在医疗系统不堪重负的情况下，饥饿和疾病状况正在恶化。

body.en:
After the earthquakes, almost 2,000 people are confirmed dead, and about 43,000 remain missing. Aid agencies warn of worsening hunger and disease amid an overwhelmed healthcare system.

Rescuers in Venezuela raced to find survivors on Tuesday, nearly a week after twin earthquakes devastated parts of the country.

Following the magnitude 7.2 and 7.5 earthquakes striking just seconds apart last week, according to numbers collated by the Venezuelan government, opposition, UNICEF, and National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA):

However, the pace of rescues has slowed sharply as the critical survival window of 72 hours has closed .

On Tuesday, rescue teams from Ecuador and the US halted operations in Macuto, La Guaira, after they stopped receiving responses from a mother and her three children trapped beneath the rubble of a building after more than 40 hours of trying ​to get them out.

"In the end, we believe the days have already passed and that what we will find now is death," said Major Jorge Montanero, leader of the Ecuadorian team.

Hope still lingers in some cases as a Jordanian rescue team pulled a three-year-old boy alive from the rubble in Caracas on Tuesday, one of the few survivors found in recent days.

Meanwhile, aid agencies warned of worsening hunger, disease and an overwhelmed healthcare system.

The World Food Programme (WFP) has appealed for $50 million (€43.83 million) to provide emergency food assistance to up to 500,000 people over the next three months.

The World Health Organization (WHO) warned on Tuesday of the strain on Venezuela's healthcare system.

WHO said at least three health centers were critically damaged and six others only partially functional.

Christian Lindmeier, the WHO spokesperson, sounded the alarm bells over the spread of measles, malaria, yellow fever and dengue among the thousands of displaced due to lack of sanitary facilities and low inoculation rates.

title.en: 'She has such an aura': The 20-year-old Aussie who just beat Serena Williams at Wimbledon
title.zh: “她有如此光环”：这位20岁的澳大利亚选手刚刚在温布尔登击败了塞雷娜·威廉姆斯

summary.en: Australian tennis player Maya Joint, 20, achieved a career-best victory by defeating tennis legend Serena Williams at Wimbledon.
summary.zh: 20岁的澳大利亚网球新星玛雅·乔因特在温布尔登网球公开赛上击败网球传奇塞雷娜·威廉姆斯，取得了职业生涯的最佳战绩。

body.en:
Serena Williams' Wimbledon comeback at 44 has been sensationally dynamited on Centre Court by Australian Maya Joint, who delivered a stunning performance to out-battle and finally subdue the hugely impressive returning legend.

In the match of her life, the 20-year-old Queenslander produced the best display of her career to prevail 6-3 6-7 (6-8) 6-3, withstanding everything that the player who may be the game's greatest ever could throw at her.

Joint overcame the disappointment of missing out on a match point when on the verge of a straight-sets win, then battled back after Williams had roared into a third-set lead to seal a monumental triumph in a two-hour 22-minute classic.

The emotional victory left Joint, who grew up in the US state of Michigan where Williams was also born, almost dumbfounded.

"I didn't get much sleep last night, I was up 'til 2 am just thinking about it. She has such an aura, she's such a legend," she told the crowd.

"I've been dreaming about this moment since I was a little kid, so this is pretty crazy."

Williams left her old Centre Court domain as she'd entered it, to thunderous cheers from the crowd, and she offered a wave to all sides, which had a real valedictory feel.

For though she may have been more than half-a-step slower and inevitably rusty after nearly four years away from singles action, she was still astonishingly impressive, three months before her 45th birthday against one of the sport's rising stars.

Yet her US-born opponent stayed strong, even as seemingly all the crowd were baying for a sentimental Serena triumph under the roof, perhaps proving how much the game has moved on in the 23-time slam champion's absence.

Joint had lost 13 of her previous 14 matches stretching back to January and had dropped to No.87 to be only the Australian No.4, but she was still a cut above the old champion, who threw in 190km/h-plus serves and occasional rocket groundstrokes, only to have them, for the large part, returned with interest.

In a way, Joint, a shy, self-effacing figure who jokingly refers to herself as the "Ginger Ninja", looked the perfect opponent for Williams, a rising star suffering a difficult 'second-season' slump who looked as if she might fold under pressure.

The opposite proved true, though. Yes, Joint did succumb at the end of the second stanza, but she only responded even more fiercely in the decider when the 23-time grand slam champion earned a break for 2-1, moving into her first lead in the final set.

Joint took the next four games as the physical toll began to tell on the mother-of-two, and there was even the sign of a limp at the end of her first singles...

reflection.en: An athlete's dedication to training for a perishable crown reminds us of the discipline required for any significant achievement. Maya Joint's remarkable victory at Wimbledon reflects immense effort, yet it also invites us to consider what truly endures beyond fleeting triumphs.
reflection.zh: 运动员为赢得那会朽坏的冠冕而付出的努力，提醒我们任何重大成就都需要坚韧不拔的纪律。玛雅·乔因特在温布尔登的非凡胜利体现了巨大的付出，但也邀请我们思考，除了转瞬即逝的胜利之外，真正永存的是什么。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Police hunt for Monaco bomb suspect after Ukrainian tycoon wounded
title.zh: 摩纳哥警方搜捕炸弹嫌疑人，乌克兰大亨受伤

summary.en: Police in Monaco are searching for a suspect after a Ukrainian tycoon was wounded in a bombing incident. The attack has shaken the ultra-safe principality, known for being home to some of the world's wealthiest individuals.
summary.zh: 摩纳哥警方正在搜捕一名炸弹袭击嫌疑人，此前一名乌克兰大亨在爆炸中受伤。这起事件震惊了这个以拥有全球最富有居民而闻名的、极其安全的公国。

body.en:
Police on Wednesday were searching for the suspect behind a parcel bomb that seriously wounded a sanctioned multi-millionaire of Ukrainian origin and two others in Monaco, after the unprecedented attack rocked the super-safe principality.

Officers in Monaco and neighbouring France were hunting for a man in a black fisherman's hat who appeared in surveillance footage after leaving a package in a residential building near the border, authorities said.

The device exploded at around 9 pm on Monday (5 am Tuesday AEST), leaving a man and a woman seriously wounded and a 13-year-old with lighter injuries, according to the Monegasque authorities.

Monaco public prosecutor Stephane Thibault said as of Tuesday the man had been stabilised, but the woman's condition remained "life-threatening".

He said the blast was being investigated as "attempted murder" but was not being considered as a "terrorist" act.

He declined to say who was the presumed target of the blast, but several sources have said it was Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolaiev, who is a permanent resident of Monaco and has acquired Cypriot nationality.

Yermolaiev is a sanctioned multi-millionaire with a reportedly long list of enemies in his homeland.

Kyiv alleges the 58-year-old maintained an alcohol business in Russia-annexed Crimea — paying taxes to Moscow even after it invaded Ukraine in 2022.

A source told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency that people would have been lining up to gun the construction magnate down in Dnipro, the industrial Ukrainian city where he made his wealth.

Monaco's Minister of State Christophe Mirmand said he was not aware of any specific threats against Yermolaiev.

"The family's behaviour before entering their block of flats did not appear to show any signs of concern on their part," he told broadcaster BFMTV.

"They were dressed for summer, relaxed and did not appear to be taking any particular precautions," he added.

The wounded had been taken to hospital in the southern French city of Nice. A source close to the case had said the man had suffered severe burns and the woman was in critical condition.

John Bulanadi, a 19-year-old student living near the site of the incident, told AFPTV he had heard a loud explosion.

"I quickly went out onto my terrace to see what was happening. There was screaming, crying and two people on the ground," he said.

Monaco's Prince Albert II described the incident as a "heinous crime" and "a shock to the entire Monegasque community".

He and his wife Princess Charlene visited police and civil defence in the afternoon, the palace said.

title.en: Israel peace deal greeted with skepticism, fear in Lebanon
title.zh: 以色列和平协议在黎巴嫩引发怀疑和恐惧

summary.en: Lebanese citizens, including those critical of Hezbollah, have expressed deep concern and skepticism regarding the peace deal signed between their government and neighboring Israel.
summary.zh: 黎巴嫩公民，包括那些批评真主党的人，对他们的政府与邻国以色列签署的和平协议表达了深切的担忧和怀疑。

body.en:
Even Lebanese locals who don't like Hezbollah, the local group fighting Israel, are deeply concerned about the deal their government has made with the neighboring country.

Despite it being heralded as "the beginning of the beginning" of peace between Israel and Lebanon by the US' top diplomat Marco Rubio, the framework that's meant to end hostilities has been greeted with much skepticism. 

Fighting between Lebanese group Hezbollah and neighboring Israel has displaced over a million people in Lebanon as the Israeli military has taken over a so-called "security buffer zone." Irael says it wants to protect its own citizens living near the border in northern Israel from Hezbollah attacks.

The latest fighting between the two belligerents, who have been opposed to one another for decades, began early March after Iran-aligned Hezbollah fired rockets at Israel, in retaliation for Israel's assassination of Iranian leader Ali Khamenei.

And since March, Israeli attacks have killed over 4,000 Lebanese and injured over 12,000. It is thought that at least 34 Israeli soldiers have been killed in the fighting.

To stop the violence, the US has overseen five rounds of direct talks between Lebanon and Israel. Last Friday, the result: A "trilateral framework" that would help the two countries move towards a peaceful settlement, agreed upon by both Israel and Lebanon as well as the US, which says it will support and monitor the agreement.

The framework, which specifies that the Lebanese government must disarm Hezbollah before Israeli troops withdraw from Lebanon, was obviously not going to please Hezbollah.

In the hours after the deal was announced, Hezbollah supporters protested in Beirut, burning tires and running amok near government buildings.

On Saturday, Hezbollah leader Naim Kassem denounced the framework, saying it was "humiliating, shameful, and a surrender of sovereignty." Kassem also said it could well see Lebanese land permanently annexed by Israel. Israeli troops currently occupy around 600 square kilometers in Lebanon.

Hezbollah plays a major role in Lebanese society, having had the support of most of the country's Shiite Muslim population. It has a political and social wing too and is often described as a "state within a state."

The reaction of Hezbollah and its supporters was to be expected, observers said. But other Lebanese are also questioning the deal.

"In general, I am against the war and how it started," says Raymond Khoury, a 39-year-old living in Beirut, referring to how Hezbollah fired rockets at Israel in March.

title.en: Can Thailand, Cambodia unlock massive oil and gas reserves?
title.zh: 泰国和柬埔寨能否解锁巨额油气储备？

summary.en: An estimated $300 billion in oil and gas reserves is sitting under overlapping territory in the Gulf of Thailand. Cooperation on its extraction is complicated by political tensions over a separate land border dispute.
summary.zh: 泰国湾重叠海域下方蕴藏着估计价值3000亿美元的油气储备。由于两国在另一陆地边界争端上的政治紧张，其开采合作变得复杂。

body.en:
An estimated $300 billion in oil and gas reserves is sitting under overlapping territory in the Gulf of Thailand. Cooperation on its extraction is complicated by political tensions over a separate land border dispute.

Cambodia and Thailand are trying out an obscure United Nations tool to try and settle a decades-long maritime territorial dispute that could lead to unlocking hundreds of billions of dollars in oil and gas reserves.

Earlier this month, Phnom Penh filed a notice for "compulsory consultation" under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, which Cambodia and Thailand are both party to.

In effect, that invited Thailand to join Cambodia in UN-backed conciliation talks over their 26,000 square kilometers (10,000 square miles) of overlapping claims in the Gulf of Thailand.

The filing comes after Thailand in May pulled out of a 2001 agreement with Cambodia that had committed the pair to settling the competing claims and jointly developing the oil and gas fields.

Thailand's pullout of the memorandum of understanding comes amid tensions between the neighbors that have been running high since a land border dispute turned deadly last year .

"The compulsory conciliation process may be useful in helping Cambodia and Thailand achieve an agreement on overlapping maritime claims," said Matthew Wheeler, a senior Southeast Asia analyst for the International Crisis Group.

Under the process of the UN convention's conciliation clause, Cambodia and Thailand have each selected two independent experts as "conciliators" to the ad hoc "conciliation commission."

The commission will investigate the facts and legal position of ​each state to deliver a set of nonbinding recommendations, which are also sent in a report to the UN ​secretary-general.

According to estimates cited by both the Thai and Cambodian governments, the overlapping claims area in the Gulf of Thailand may hold $300 billion (€263 billion) worth of untapped oil and gas reserves by some rough estimates, including 11 trillion cubic feet of natural gas alone.

"Both countries would benefit substantially. Thailand's oil fields … have been in decline for a few years, leading to [liquefied natural gas] imports." said William Jones, an assistant professor at Thailand's Mahidol University.

Cambodia, meanwhile, is entirely dependent on imports for its oil and gas. And without any refineries of its own, Jones said, it would likely have to send any oil and gas it extracts from the Gulf to Thailand for processing, at least until it develops its own capacity.

"Regardless, given the high energy prices, dependency levels and now the added uncertainty from the Middle East, the Gulf of Thailand would provide a good buffer for consumption and healthy profits for those involved," Jones told...
body.zh: 泰国湾重叠领土内蕴藏着估计价值 3000 亿美元的石油和天然气储量。由于另一个陆地边界争端引发的政治紧张局势，开采合作变得更加复杂。 柬埔寨和泰国正在尝试一项不起眼的联合国工具，试图解决长达数十年的海上领土争端，这可能会释放数千亿美元的石油和天然气储备。 本月早些时候，金边根据柬埔寨和泰国同为缔约方的《联合国海洋法公约》提交了“强制磋商”通知。 实际上，这邀请泰国与柬埔寨一起参加联合国支持的和解谈判，讨论两国在泰国湾 26,000 平方公里（10,000 平方英里）的重叠领土主张。 泰国于 5 月退出了 2001 年与柬埔寨达成的协议，该协议承诺两国解决相互竞争的索赔并共同开发油气田，之后提交了这份文件。 泰国退出谅解备忘录之际，邻国之间的紧张关系自去年陆地边界争端变得致命以来一直处于高度紧张状态。 国际危机组织东南亚高级分析师马修·惠勒表示：“强制调解程序可能有助于帮助柬埔寨和泰国就重叠的海事主张达成协议。” 根据联合国公约的调解条款，柬埔寨和泰国各自选出了两名独立专家作为特设“调解委员会”的“调解员”。 该委员会将调查每个国家的事实和法律立场，以提出一系列不具约束力的建议，这些建议也会通过报告发送给联合国秘书长。 根据泰国和柬埔寨政府引用的估计，粗略估计，泰国湾的重叠索赔区域可能蕴藏着价值 3000 亿美元（2630 亿欧元）的未开发石油和天然气储量，其中仅包括 11 万亿立方英尺的天然气。 “两国都将受益匪浅。泰国的油田……几年来一直在下降，导致[液化天然气]进口。”泰国玛希隆大学助理教授威廉·琼斯说。 与此同时，柬埔寨的石油和天然气完全依赖进口。琼斯表示，如果没有自己的炼油厂，它可能不得不将从海湾开采的任何石油和天然气运往泰国进行加工，至少在它发展自己的产能之前是这样。 琼斯表示：“无论如何，考虑到能源价格高企、依赖程度高，以及中东地区增加的不确定性，泰国湾将为消费提供良好的缓冲，并为相关人员带来可观的利润。”

reflection.en: Thailand and Cambodia sit on vast shared wealth, yet political tensions prevent its extraction. This echoes the wisdom that peace and good relations are more valuable than material riches gained through conflict or withheld by animosity. Prioritizing cooperation, even amidst past disputes, can unlock mutual prosperity for all.
reflection.zh: 泰国和柬埔寨拥有巨大的共享财富，但政治紧张局势阻碍了其开采。这与“有爱胜过丰盛的宴席”的智慧不谋而合，表明和平与良好关系比通过冲突获得或因敌意而搁置的物质财富更有价值。即使在过去的争端中，优先考虑合作也能为双方带来共同的繁荣。

title.en: A plane crashed into a tower in Beijing but China is not saying what happened
title.zh: 一架飞机在北京撞上大楼，但中国未说明情况

summary.en: A plane reportedly crashed into a tower in Beijing, leaving visible damage. However, authorities have removed other traces of the incident and have not provided an explanation.
summary.zh: 据报道，一架飞机在北京撞上了一座大楼，造成了明显的损坏。然而，当局已经清除了事件的其他痕迹，并且没有提供任何解释。

body.en:
It has been four days since a small plane slammed into Beijing's tallest skyscraper , killing the pilot – the only person on board – and wounding 13 others, but it's still unclear why, and how, that happened.

A 60-word report detailing the basic facts in state-owned Beijing Daily is the only official statement China has published so far on the crash, which happened just a few kilometres from Zhongnanhai, the Communist Party's headquarters.

Friday's collision left holes on the side of the 109-storey CITIC Tower, which have since been boarded up. Dramatic footage of the incident has been scrubbed off the internet. At least three aviation firms tell the BBC they've been told to suspend light aircraft operations but declined to elaborate, saying they had been instructed not to discuss it.

Amid the information vacuum, speculation is mounting as to how the aircraft managed to penetrate a city which has some of the world's strictest airspace controls.

China is no stranger to censorship. Criticism of the party, the country's leaders or the government is rare, and any discussions that seem critical, have political implications or touch upon sensitive issues quickly disappear.

But this time it has gone well beyond the obvious targets. Photographs and memes of the skyscraper, which are unrelated to Friday's incident, have also been removed from Chinese social media platforms.

Shaped like a Chinese wine vessel, the building is a local crowd-puller. Many see it as a lucky charm and young people wishing for good fortune, from exam results to jobs, either stop by or share photos of it online, along with a quick prayer.

The censorship machinery kicked in so quickly and thoroughly this time possibly because Beijing's leadership is "still not exactly sure what happened", says Manya Koetse, who runs the Eye on Digital China newsletter.

"This is a highly unusual incident," she says, adding that it calls into question government competence and threatens "important party narratives".

Even those aviation firms that confirmed to the BBC that authorities have grounded light aircraft operations since the incident did not wish to say more.

"We were told to not speak about it. Please ask others," said a lady at a flight training institute in Beijing.

Another firm in Chengdu declined to specify which authority the instruction came from, and promptly ended the call.

Beijing enforces a permanent no-fly zone of roughly 100 sq km (39 sq miles) over its political core covering Tiananmen Square and Zhongnanhai, the heavily guarded compound where the country's top leaders live and work .

title.en: China is a clear winner from Trump’s war in Middle East, report concludes

reflection.en: This news reminds us of the destructive power of greed, as the pursuit of wealth can lead individuals to betray trust and cause widespread harm. Yahweh's word warns that the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, often leading to sorrow and ruin.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻提醒我们贪婪的破坏力，对财富的追求可能导致个人背弃信任并造成广泛的伤害。雅伟的话语警告说，贪财是万恶之根，常常带来悲伤和毁灭。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.

title.en: EU sets up three months of talks with China over €360bn trade deficit
title.zh: 欧盟就3600亿欧元贸易逆差与中国展开为期三个月的谈判

summary.en: The European Union and China have agreed to three months of talks to address a significant €360bn trade deficit, aiming to create a more balanced bilateral relationship and avert a potential trade war after weeks of rising tensions.
summary.zh: 欧盟与中国已同意进行为期三个月的谈判，以解决高达3600亿欧元的贸易逆差问题，旨在建立更平衡的双边关系，并在数周的紧张局势后避免潜在的贸易战。

body.en: Two sides agree to try to make bilateral relationship ‘more balanced’ after weeks of threats The EU and China have agreed to enter three months of talks to try to avoid a trade war over the bloc’s €360bn (£310bn) annual import/export imbalance. In their first joint statement in seven years, the two sides agreed in Brussels to open a formal trade consultation after weeks of threats and recriminations from China if the EU imposed any measures to stop the flood of goods and components into the bloc. Continue reading...
body.zh: 经过数周的威胁，双方同意努力使双边关系“更加平衡” 欧盟和中国同意进行为期三个月的谈判，以避免因欧盟每年 3600 亿欧元（3100 亿英镑）的进出口失衡而爆发贸易战。在七年来的首份联合声明中，双方同意在布鲁塞尔举行正式贸易磋商，此前中国连续数周发出威胁和指责，如果欧盟采取任何措施阻止商品和零部件大量涌入欧盟，两国将启动正式贸易磋商。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world often quick to escalate disputes, the agreement between the EU and China to engage in talks to resolve trade imbalances offers a hopeful example of pursuing peace. Yahweh's word encourages us to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, seeking common ground even amidst significant disagreements. This diplomatic effort reflects a...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常迅速升级争端的世界里，欧盟与中国同意通过谈判解决贸易不平衡问题，提供了一个追求和平的充满希望的范例。雅伟的话语鼓励我们，只要我们能做到，就尽力与所有人和平相处，即使在重大分歧中也要寻求共同点。这种外交努力体现了对话而非冲突的承诺，通过耐心的谈判争取建立平衡的关系。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Weather tracker: Heatwave expected to bring Germany and Poland to 40C
title.zh: 天气追踪：德国和波兰预计将迎来40摄氏度高温热浪

summary.en: An intense heatwave is expected to bring temperatures up to 40C in parts of central and northern Europe, including Germany and Poland. The Austrian Grand Prix has declared a heat hazard due to the dramatic rise in temperatures.
summary.zh: 预计一股强烈的热浪将使中欧和北欧部分地区（包括德国和波兰）的气温升至40摄氏度。由于气温急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛已宣布高温危险。

body.en: Austrian Grand Prix declares heat hazard as dramatic rise in temperatures forecast in central and northern Europe Temperatures are forecast to rise dramatically in parts of central and northern Europe this weekend as the intense heatwave continues . In Germany and Poland, highs up to or exceeding 40C (104F) are expected on both Saturday and Sunday, days after swathes of France experienced similar extreme temperatures. The Austrian Grand Prix, taking place this weekend in Spielberg, has declared a heat hazard , the first race to do so this season. Temperatures are expected to rise into the low 30s celsius during the race, almost 10C warmer than usual for the venue. Across Europe, the intense heat has led to severe thunderstorms. In the Sverdlovsk region of central Russia, a strong tornado was reported on the evening of 22 June. Rated a 3 out of 5 on the international Fujita scale, the twister injured 16 people and destroyed or damaged about 100 homes and businesses in the town of Kushva. Emergency services have been working on restoring power to the town. Tornadoes are not unheard of in Russia but are rare. Forecasters say they may become more common in future as the climate breaks down. Storm warnings remained in effect in the southern part of the country on Friday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预计中欧和北欧气温将急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛宣布存在热危险 随着强烈热浪的持续，预计本周末中欧和北欧部分地区气温将大幅上升。在德国和波兰，预计周六和周日气温将达到或超过 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），几天前法国大片地区也经历了类似的极端气温。本周末在斯皮尔伯格举行的奥地利大奖赛已宣布出现高温危险，这是本赛季第一场这样做的比赛。预计比赛期间气温将升至 30 摄氏度，比平时高出近 10 摄氏度。在整个欧洲，酷热导致了严重的雷暴天气。 6月22日晚，俄罗斯中部斯维尔德洛夫斯克地区报告出现强烈龙卷风。国际藤田等级评定为 3 级（满分 5 级），龙卷风造成 16 人受伤，并摧毁或损坏了库什瓦镇约 100 所房屋和企业。紧急服务部门一直致力于恢复该镇的供电。龙卷风在俄罗斯并非闻所未闻，但很罕见。预报员表示，随着气候的恶化，它们未来可能会变得更加普遍。周五，该国南部地区的风暴警告仍然有效。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic rise in temperatures across Europe reminds us that creation itself is experiencing distress. As the natural world groans under changing conditions, we are called to reflect on our interconnectedness with the earth and its well-being. This intense heatwave serves as a poignant reminder of the broader challenges facing our shared home.
reflection.zh: 欧洲气温的急剧上升提醒我们，受造界本身正在经历痛苦。当自然界在不断变化的环境下发出呻吟时，我们被呼召反思我们与地球及其福祉的相互关联。这场强烈热浪是对我们共同家园所面临的更广泛挑战的深刻提醒。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Xi Jinping has hosted more than a dozen leaders this year, as ‘middle powers’ look beyond the US
title.zh: 习近平今年接待了十几位领导人，‘中间力量’超越美国寻求合作

summary.en: China's leader, Xi Jinping, has hosted numerous world leaders this year, aiming to promote an alternative global order. This effort is reportedly aided by the perceived unpredictability of the United States, prompting 'middle powers' to explore new international alignments.
summary.zh: 中国领导人习近平今年接待了多位世界各国领导人，旨在推动一种替代性的全球秩序。据报道，美国的反复无常助长了这一努力，促使“中等强国”寻求新的国际结盟。

body.en: China’s leader wants to promote his alternative to the current world order, and his efforts are being assisted by a capricious US Xi Jinping meets Bangladesh’s new prime minister on Friday, the latest in a wave of world leaders to visit Beijing this year as the Chinese leader builds his influence and economic ties, and seeks to “shift the balance of power” away from the west. Xi’s meeting with Tarique Rahman comes less than two weeks after the Chinese leader welcomed Myanmar’s military chief-turned-president, Min Aung Hlaing, in Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国领导人希望推行他对当前世界秩序的替代方案，他的努力得到了反复无常的美国的协助。习近平周五会见了孟加拉国新总理，这是今年访问北京的一波世界领导人中最新的一位，中国领导人正在建立影响力和经济联系，并寻求“改变力量平衡”，远离西方。习近平与塔里克·拉赫曼的会面是在中国领导人在北京欢迎缅甸军方最高领导人、现任总统敏昂莱之后不到两周。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights how nations are drawn to leaders who articulate a clear vision for the future, especially when existing global structures seem uncertain. Proverbs 29:18 reminds us that without a guiding vision, people and nations can lose their way. This underscores the profound impact of leadership that offers a coherent path forward.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调，当现有的全球秩序显得不确定时，各国会被那些为未来描绘清晰愿景的领导人所吸引。箴言29:18提醒我们，没有指引的异象，人民和国家就会迷失方向。这突显了提供连贯前进道路的领导力所产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: UK to halve tariff-free steel imports to counter glut of cheap Chinese metal
title.zh: 英国将削减免关税钢材进口量以应对廉价中国金属过剩

summary.en: The UK government announced it will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports, doubling duties on quantities exceeding the new quota. This measure, mirrored by similar changes in EU limits, aims to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and support domestic industry.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布将把免关税钢材进口量减半，超出新配额的进口将加倍征收关税。此举与欧盟的类似调整相呼应，旨在应对全球廉价中国金属的过剩供应，并扶持本国产业。

body.en: Duty on imports outside new quota will double in move echoing similar changes in EU limits Business live – latest updates The UK government will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports allowed in an attempt to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and bolster its beleaguered local industry. New “safeguards” will be introduced on 1 July and will coincide with similar new limits being introduced by the EU for the same purposes. The UK said it and the EU had agreed an approach that reflected each other’s “highly interconnected supply chains” after months of negotiations over retaining tariff-free access between the markets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新配额之外的进口关税将翻倍，与欧盟限制的类似变化相呼应英国政府将允许的免关税钢铁进口量减半，以应对全球廉价中国金属供应过剩的问题，并提振陷入困境的当地工业。新的“保障措施”将于 7 月 1 日推出，并将与欧盟出于相同目的推出的类似新限制同时实施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often grapple with balancing economic interests and ensuring fair trade practices. Proverbs 11:1 reminds us that Yahweh values honest dealings and just measures in commerce. This principle encourages leaders to seek equitable solutions that promote integrity in global markets.
reflection.zh: 国家常在经济利益与确保公平贸易实践之间寻求平衡。箴言11:1提醒我们，雅伟看重商业中的诚实交易和公正的度量。这一原则鼓励领导者寻求公平的解决方案，以促进全球市场的诚信。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: What is China’s SpaceSail, and could it rival Elon Musk’s Starlink?
title.zh: 中国的“太空帆”是什么？它能与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争吗？

summary.en: China's state-backed SpaceSail project is developing a satellite internet constellation to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. With hundreds of satellites in low Earth orbit, the company is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries.
summary.zh: 中国国家支持的“太空帆”项目正在开发一个卫星互联网星座，旨在与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争。该公司目前在近地轨道拥有数百颗卫星，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判。

body.en: The company has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit but has state backing and is already reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries Elon Musk’s Starlink has long dominated the satellite internet industry, but a Chinese government-backed project is aiming to challenge its position. SpaceSail has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit compared with Starlink’s 10,000-plus. But the company says it now has enough satellites to begin its first commercial application, is scaling up at speed, and is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries to provide satellite internet coverage. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星，但有国家支持，据报道已经与数十个国家进行谈判。埃隆·马斯克的星链长期以来一直主导着卫星互联网行业，但一个中国政府支持的项目旨在挑战其地位。与 Starlink 的 10,000 多颗卫星相比，SpaceSail 在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星。但该公司表示，它现在拥有足够的卫星来开始其首次商业应用，并且正在快速扩大规模，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判以提供卫星互联网覆盖。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As nations and companies embark on ambitious technological ventures like SpaceSail, it reminds us of the human drive to innovate and connect the world. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our efforts, when aligned with His purposes, will find success. This perspective can guide us in all our endeavors, from grand...
reflection.zh: 当各国和公司着手像“太空帆”这样雄心勃勃的技术项目时，这提醒我们人类创新和连接世界的动力。箴言16:3鼓励我们将我们的计划交托给雅伟，相信我们的努力，若与祂的旨意相符，必将成功。这种视角可以指导我们所有的努力，无论是宏伟的项目还是日常任务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Dear You review – enjoyable Chinese romdram crosses generations as it tracks down a missing husband
title.zh: 《亲爱的你》影评：一部跨越世代、追寻失踪丈夫的感人华语爱情剧情片

summary.en: The Guardian China reviews "Dear You," a Chinese romantic drama by director Lan Hongchun. The film is a multi-generational family saga, spanning from the 1940s to the present, primarily set in Bangkok, and follows the search for a husband who disappeared in Thailand.
summary.zh: 《卫报中国》评论了导演蓝鸿春的华语爱情剧情片《亲爱的你》。这部电影是一部跨越几代人的家族传奇，故事从20世纪40年代至今，主要背景设在曼谷，讲述了一个家庭寻找在泰国失踪的丈夫的故事。

body.en: Director Lan Hongchun’s family saga feels like a good old-fashioned novel as it goes in search of a man who has disappeared in Thailand With a story that ranges from the 1940s to the present and, although mostly set in Bangkok, revolving largely around Teochew-speaking Chinese from Guangdong, this generations-spanning drama feels like a good old-fashioned novel. A romantic beach read, perhaps, the kind in which coincidences and random accidents cause misunderstandings that last for decades until the truth is finally revealed. It’s sentimental in places, sure, but there’s also a fair bit of salty, bawdy humour to cut the sweetness, lashings of period colour, and impressively naturalistic performances from a mostly non-professional cast. All that has helped to make this an unexpectedly large box-office hit in the People’s Republic last month; and for non-Chinese or Thai rom-dram aficionados anywhere, it’s well worth looking out for. As the story opens in the 21st century in the Chinese city of Shantou, octogenarian Shurou (Iap Sok-jiu) is celebrating her 87th birthday, surrounded by adoring friends, family and neighbours who revere the matriarch, not least for managing to raise three kids on her own in the 1940s and 50s. Her shifty grandson Xiaowei (Hiau-ui), however, is less of a solid citizen and, having got into debt, he decides to travel to Bangkok to find out if Shurou’s husband Zheng Musheng, not seen for decades, could help out since he’s reputed to have made a fortune out there, endowed schools all over Thailand, and had a second family after abandoning Shurou. Continue reading...
body.zh: 导演兰鸿春的家庭传奇感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说，讲述了在泰国寻找失踪男子的故事。故事范围从 20 世纪 40 年代至今，虽然主要以曼谷为背景，但主要围绕来自广东的潮州华人展开，这部跨越几代人的戏剧感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说。浪漫的海滩读物，也许是那种巧合和偶然的事故会导致持续数十年的误会，直到真相最终揭晓的类型。当然，它在某些地方是感伤的，但也有一些咸味、下流的幽默来削弱甜蜜，充满时代色彩，以及来自大多数非专业演员的令人印象深刻的自然主义表演。所有这些都使得该片上个月在中华人民共和国取得了意想不到的票房大成功。对于任何地方的非中国或泰国的浪漫剧爱好者来说，这都非常值得一看。故事发生在 21 世纪的中国汕头市，八十多岁的淑柔（叶淑如饰）正在庆祝她的 87 岁生日，周围都是崇拜这位女族长的朋友、家人和邻居，尤其是她在 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代设法独自抚养三个孩子。然而，她狡猾的孙子小伟（孝仪饰）却不是一个踏实的公民，负债累累，他决定前往曼谷，看看书柔数十年未见的丈夫郑木胜是否可以帮忙，因为他在外面发了大财，为泰国各地的学校捐款，并在抛弃书柔后有了第二个家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The multi-generational search for a missing husband in "Dear You" powerfully illustrates the enduring nature of family bonds. This long quest reflects the deep commitment inherent in marriage, where two become one, a union that transcends time and distance. It reminds us that true connection often calls for steadfastness, even in the face of profound...
reflection.zh: 电影《亲爱的你》中跨越几代人寻找失踪丈夫的故事，有力地展现了家庭纽带的持久性。这场漫长的寻觅反映了婚姻中固有的深刻承诺，夫妻二人成为一体，这种结合超越了时间和距离。它提醒我们，真正的连接往往需要坚韧不拔，即使面对巨大的不确定性也是如此。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Dettol apologises after ‘toxic men’ advert sparks backlash in China
title.zh: 滴露因“有毒男性”广告在中国引发反弹后致歉

summary.en: British hygiene brand Dettol has issued an apology after an advertisement released in China, which it stated was meant to critique “toxic men,” drew widespread condemnation. The advert, which featured a man seeking a “clean and untouched” woman, was widely criticized on social media.
summary.zh: 英国个人卫生品牌滴露为其在中国发布的一则广告致歉。该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，但因其内容涉及一名男性寻找“干净纯洁”女性的描述，在社交媒体上遭到广泛谴责。

body.en: British disinfectant brand withdraws advert about a man’s efforts to find a ‘clean and untouched’ woman The British hygiene brand Dettol has apologised after an advertisement released in China, which it said was intended to criticise “toxic men”, was widely condemned on social media as offensive to women. The five-minute advert for a multipurpose disinfectant, released across many online platforms at the end of May, features a man comparing his girlfriend with his former partner. Learning that his former girlfriend previously lived with someone else, the man likens their relationship to a “secondhand service”. He then tells his friends that he intends to find a “clean and untouched” woman for whom he can be the first sexual partner. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国消毒剂品牌撤回有关男性努力寻找“干净、未受影响”女性的广告英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告道歉，称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，该广告在社交媒体上受到广泛谴责，认为该广告冒犯了女性。五月底，多用途消毒剂的五分钟广告在多个在线平台上发布，其中一名男子将他的女朋友与他的前伴侣进行了比较。当得知他的前女友以前与别人住在一起时，该男子将他们的关系比作“二手服务”。然后他告诉他的朋友，他打算找一个“干净、未受污染”的女人作为他的第一个性伴侣。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This incident highlights how language and imagery can inadvertently diminish human dignity, especially when portraying individuals as objects rather than persons of inherent worth. Yahweh created humanity in His own image, bestowing equal value and respect upon every individual, regardless of gender or societal expectations. Our words and actions should...
reflection.zh: 这起事件凸显了语言和形象如何可能在无意中贬低人的尊严，尤其当它将个体描绘成物品而非具有内在价值的人时。雅伟照着自己的形象创造了人类，赋予每个人平等的价值和尊重，无论性别或社会期望如何。我们的言行应始终反映这一基本真理，尊重每个人的神圣价值。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Australia Desk
title.zh: 澳洲栏目

strap.en: Public life, policy, and community stories shaping Australia now.
strap.zh: 关注正在影响澳洲公共生活、政策与社区的新闻。

title.en: Australia politics live: Albanese says Coalition and One Nation an ‘axis of grievance’ as Taylor questions Labor on cost of living
title.zh: 澳大利亚政治直播：阿尔巴尼斯称联盟党和一国党为“不满的轴心”，泰勒就生活成本问题质询工党

summary.en: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese characterized the Coalition and One Nation parties as an "axis of grievance," while the opposition questioned the Labor government on the cost of living. Separately, Albanese commented on charges against EY employees who accessed the Prime Minister’s bank account details,...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯将联盟党和一国党描述为“不满的轴心”，而反对党则就生活成本问题质询工党政府。此外，阿尔巴尼斯还就安永（EY）员工获取总理银行账户详情的指控发表评论，并指出毕马威（KPMG）也正受到审查。

body.en: Follow today’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Albanese says charges against EY employees who accessed PM’s bank account details ‘appropriate’ It’s not just KPMG in (boiling) hot water right now; EY is also in the spotlight, after two of its graduate employees on secondment at the Commonwealth Bank allegedly used the bank’s systems to access the personal details of Anthony Albanese . The two employees have been sacked. It’s before the courts and I’m not about to go into the detail of that. It’s appropriate that charges have been laid …accessing anyone’s privacy, any Australian’s privacy, is alarming, let alone someone from a contractor who’s not an employee of Commonwealth Bank being able to access that information. The Socceroos' World Cup lunchtime clash against Paraguay last Friday saw a spike in workplace no-shows, new data reveals, likely driven in part by a surge in staff calling in sick.

Rostering data provided to SBS News by workforce management software company Deputy showed absenteeism rose across the hospitality, retail, and services sectors.

The data tracked rostered shifts that went unworked and did not differentiate between those who called in sick, took annual leave or were no-shows.

But the increase in absenteeism, also seen during Australia's earlier World Cup fixtures, corresponded with the Socceroos' matches, suggesting at least some were calling in sick.

Socceroos supporter group Active Support dubbed the Paraguay match the "great Australian Socceroos sickie" as a "mysterious case of football fever" swept across the nation, and some fans told SBS News they planned to "chuck a sickie".
